headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headings. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for all body text, labels, and table data. Ensures readability.

typography.instructions: Import Outfit and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css or index.html.

visual_enhancers.cards: rounded-2xl, subtle border (border-white/10), solid surface background (no heavy drop shadows). Generous padding (p-6 to p-8).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for modals, dropdowns, and sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, and border-white/10 inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.charts: Radial/circular progress indicators for 0-100 scores. Sparkline-style trend lines for momentum. Use Recharts with electric violet stroke colors and subtle gradient fills.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Cards should have a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle border highlight on hover. Buttons should use a slight brightness increase.

layouts.general: Mobile-first responsive grids. Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12).
layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid strategy: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.
layouts.bento_grid: For the Idea Lab and Creator DNA: asymmetrical span logic (e.g., col-span-2 row-span-2 for primary visual, col-span-1 for stats).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Primary button uses solid Electric Violet background with white text. Secondary button uses transparent background with border-white/10 and white text.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav or left sidebar. Must include branding, 3-5 links, and a primary CTA. Use glassmorphism if top nav.
components.badges_labels: Uppercase, tiny text (text-xs), wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]), soft background (bg-white/5) or soft violet (bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-400).
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. For 'Propose Collaboration' modal, ensure a premium glassmorphism overlay and solid dark surface for the dialog box.

motion.dna_reveal: MANDATORY: 3-4s staged sequence. Use framer-motion staggerChildren. Checkmarks and data pillars appearing sequentially with a brief delay. This is the 'wow moment'.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up (y: 10 to y: 0) for new pages/views.
motion.micro_interactions: All interactive elements must have hover/focus transitions (excluding transforms from `transition-all`).

abstract_backgrounds.description: Abstract purple glowing lines, good for hero section or DNA reveal background
Abstract purple and black wavy pattern, good for card accents

creators.description: Asian woman in blue sweater - use for 'Sarah Chen' profile
Male content creator - use for user's own avatar or other collaboration suggestions

thumbnails.description: Smartphone showing YouTube channel page, useful for Opportunity feed context or video references

libraries.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Install via yarn add @phosphor-icons/react). Use Duotone weight for a premium tech look.
libraries.charts: recharts (Install via yarn add recharts). Use for radial progress, sparklines, and bubble charts for Trend Radar.
libraries.motion: framer-motion (Install via yarn add framer-motion). Essential for DNA reveal sequence.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Minimal 4.5:1 for normal text. Use text shadow over images.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus states for all interactive elements, matching accent color.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a premium, dark-mode 5-day contest submission ready MVP for CreatorOS. Implement landing page, DNA reveal animation, opportunity feed, trend radar, idea lab, and creator profile.
instructions_to_main_agent.data: Use seeded/demo data for all feeds, profiles, and trends to ensure the UI is fully populated and demo-ready.
instructions_to_main_agent.design_system: Strictly follow the color palette (Background: #0A0A0F, Accent: Electric Violet). Use Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text. All cards must be rounded-2xl with subtle border (border-white/10).
features_to_implement: Public landing / showcase (no login) with 'View Demo' CTA.
Animated Creator DNA reveal sequence (3-4s staged checkmarks).
Creator DNA dashboard (pillars, formats, style, audience interests).
Opportunity detail with 'How was this calculated?' breakdown.
Trend Radar (visual bubble/list of 6-10 seeded trends).
Creator profile (Sarah Chen) + compatibility score + Propose Collab modal.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
